sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you create an account we collect your name, mobile number and email. When you use the platform we store your exam attempts, answers and results so we can show your progress and reports.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to run your account, deliver exams, calculate your results, manage your subscriptions and payments, and contact you about your account or support requests.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Card payments are processed by our payment provider. We do not store your full card number on our servers.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers that help us operate the platform (such as payment processing), or when required by law.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can view and update your profile information from your account settings, and you can contact us to request deletion of your account and data.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your login details private. An account is for one person and may not be shared.

sections.heading: Subscriptions
sections.body: A package gives you access to the exams and question bank of its specialty for the subscription period. Access ends when the subscription expires unless you renew it.

sections.heading: Payments and refunds
sections.body: Prices are shown before you pay. Refunds follow the policy shown at the time of purchase.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Exam content is for your personal preparation. Copying, publishing or redistributing questions is not allowed.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. We will publish the updated version on this page.

modes.q: What is the difference between exam mode and study mode?
modes.a: Exam mode simulates the real exam and shows your result at the end. Study mode shows the correct answer and its explanation after each question.

timer.q: What happens when the exam time runs out?
timer.a: The exam is submitted automatically and your answers so far are graded.

review.q: Can I review the questions I got wrong?
review.a: Yes. You can save and flag questions, review each attempt, and practice again on your mistakes.

payment.q: How do I pay for a package?
payment.a: By card through the secure HyperPay gateway; your card details never reach our servers.
